(Easter was in early March that year.)2w5Beth A Truax ZwickyI put Kool-Aid in the shower nozzle. The look on my daughters face when she came and said the water was purple…..priceless2w7Tracy RinasMy oldest was 6.5 and I was pregnant due end of April and on her own she called grandma and told her the baby was on its way. After a few minutes she said April fools. She hung up and looked at me and said I didn’t lie. I just didn’t tell her it wasn’t today. My mother in law laughed about that for years.2w18View 1 replyGinny Doyle FerjaniI told my kids that they didn't have school today. They were jumping and cheering until I said "April Fools". They were so mad at me the rest of the morning. When I dropped them off the teachers were laughing at their grumpy faces.1w2View 1 replyBrejan Nelson EdwardsNASA going back to the moon is a good one today. Except no one believes it.2w3View 1 replyKathy EretI told my husband that he just got a HUGE box delivered, he was looking online to see what it was . I got him good that year . That ship has sailed. April fools2w1Patrick LindquistThis one time on April 1st I got up early and took uncooked white rice and carefully inserted it into my family's toothbrushes. Hoping that their sleepy eyes in the morning wouldn't see it. It worked with my ex-wife. She freaked out and thought it was maggots.
